title: Location of Chisht town
subject: Geography
caption: Map showing the location of Chisht town in central Afghanistan.
altText: A textbook-quality map of Afghanistan on a white background, displaying provincial borders, major cities such as Kabul, Herat, Kandahar, and Mazar-i-Sharif, with a red circular pin marking the town of Chisht in the central region. All labels are clear and legible, a legend identifies the pin, a scale bar and north arrow are present, and subtle shading indicates terrain.
